FN-G0VE26-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 430
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/09/2023
House Bill 430 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama State Department
of Education by an estimated minimum of $1,900 annually by adding five members to the
Literacy Task Force. This bill would also codify the current practice of reimbursing task force
members for expenses incurred in performance of their duties.
